ledger: Skater | Riding in goofy stance | Completes two tricks and continues riding | Performs a flip trick, lands, then performs an ollie
Skateboard | Rolling on ground | Rolling on ground | Pops and flips, clipping through skater's foot mid-air, lands, pops again for an ollie
Skater's Right Foot (Front) | Planted on front of board | Planted on front of board | Flicks board to initiate flip, hovers, is clipped by rotating board, lands back on board

findings.description: As the skateboard completes its rotation during the flip trick, the nose of the board passes directly through the heel area of the skater's right red shoe and green sock. The solid objects intersect without any collision or deflection.
